### Century Communities to Celebrate October Grand Opening of Rainier Ridge Estates, Offering New Homes in Enumclaw, WA


October 20, 2026


Rambler and two-story floor plans from the high $700s debut in the Mount Rainier foothills, with homes released for sale on Grand Opening day


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Grand Opening Event:** Century Communities will host a Rainier Ridge Estates Grand Opening in Enumclaw, Washington, on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
- **Pricing and Sales Release:** Homes at Rainier Ridge Estates in Enumclaw, Washington, are priced from the high $700s and will be released for sale beginning October 24, 2026.
- **Floor Plan Collection:** Rainier Ridge Estates offers rambler and two-story floor plans from 2,099 to 3,283 sq. ft., with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3.75 bathrooms, and 2- to 3-car garages.
- **Model Home:** The professionally merchandised model at Rainier Ridge Estates showcases the two-story Shenandoah plan, featuring 2,949 sq. ft., a main-level guest suite, and a covered patio.
- **Schools and Location:** Rainier Ridge Estates is served by Enumclaw School District and sits about 30 miles from Tacoma, 41 miles from Crystal Mountain Resort, and 45 miles from downtown Seattle.


ENUMCLAW, Wash.


, Oct. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced it will open Rainier Ridge Estates, a new community of single-family homes in Enumclaw, with a Grand Opening celebration on Saturday, October 24, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. The 87-homesite community will release its first homes for sale that day, offering rambler and two-story designs from the high $700s, set against the backdrop of the Mount Rainier foothills.


Grand Opening guests can explore available homesites and floor plans, tour the professionally merchandised Shenandoah model, meet with the Century Communities team, learn about limited-time Grand Opening financing opportunities, and enjoy seasonal refreshments and activities for all ages.


**Learn more, join the interest list, and RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/RainierRidgeGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802285-1&h=452772044&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FRainierRidgeGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FRainierRidgeGO) **.**


"Rainier Ridge Estates offers Enumclaw buyers more space, more choice, and a real connection to the outdoors, with 10 versatile floor plans set in the foothills of Mount Rainier," said Mick Cermak, Division President. "From ramblers to two-story plans with options like main-level guest suites and multigenerational layouts, there's a home here for every stage of life. Join us at our Grand Opening on October 24 to tour our new model and find the home that checks every box on your wish list."


The collection ranges from the Biscayne, a rambler with 2,099 sq. ft., 3 bedrooms, and 2 bathrooms, to the Garrett, a two-story plan with 3,283 sq. ft., 5 bedrooms, and 3.5 bathrooms. Select plans feature vaulted great rooms, multigenerational living options, and 3-car garages, and the community features expansive homesites and cul-de-sac lots.


**RAINIER RIDGE ESTATES | ENUMCLAW, WA** *Grand Opening on 10/24 | Coming soon from the high $700s*


- 87 single-family homesites, including cul-de-sac homesites
- Rambler and two-story floor plans from 2,099 to 3,283 sq. ft.
- 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3.75 bathrooms, and 2- to 3-car garages
- Select plans offer flexible living spaces, main-floor guest suites, multigenerational options, 3-car garages, and expansive homesites
- Served by Enumclaw School District: Sunrise Elementary School, Enumclaw Middle School and Enumclaw High School
- Proximity to outdoor recreation: Pinnacle Peak Park is about 4 miles away; Nolte State Park and Deep Lake are about 8 miles; Foothills Trail is about 15 miles
- Mount Rainier National Park about 40 miles away; Crystal Mountain Resort is about 41 miles away; Tacoma about 30 miles away; and downtown Seattle about 45 miles away


**Community Location** 44807 244th Avenue SE
Enumclaw, WA 98022
425.275.5119

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** When is the Grand Opening of Rainier Ridge Estates in Enumclaw, WA?
**Answer:** The Grand Opening of Rainier Ridge Estates will be held on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Homes at Rainier Ridge Estates will be released for sale starting that day.


**Question:** What are new homes priced from at Rainier Ridge Estates?
**Answer:** As of October 2026, new homes at Rainier Ridge Estates are priced from the high $700s, with 10 floor plans from 2,099 to 3,283 sq. ft.


**Question:** Does Rainier Ridge Estates offer rambler homes?
**Answer:** Yes. Rainier Ridge Estates offers two rambler floor plans—the Biscayne with 2,099 sq. ft. and the Summit with 2,393 sq. ft.—alongside a selection of two-story plans.


**Question:** What schools serve Rainier Ridge Estates?
**Answer:** Rainier Ridge Estates is served by Enumclaw School District, including Sunrise Elementary School, Enumclaw Middle School, and Enumclaw High School.


**Question:** How far is Rainier Ridge Estates from Seattle and Tacoma?
**Answer:** Rainier Ridge Estates is about 45 miles from downtown Seattle, 30 miles from Tacoma, and 32 miles from Sea-Tac International Airport.
